description: Compares and ranks US mobile phone plans, cheapest first, from a curated catalog of carrier and prepaid (MVNO) plans, each price checked on the provider's own page, by 12-month average cost per line, with any promo price shown alongside. The catalog is a selection, not the whole market; each result states how many plans and providers it covers and the oldest price-check date. Inputs: number of lines, and optionally data need, budget per line, prepaid or postpaid, must-have features and preferred network. No address or location is used, so network coverage is not checked; each result carries a coverage note. Keywords: cheapest phone plan, compare cell phone plans, cell phone plan, mobile plan comparison, switch carriers, unlimited data plan, family plan, prepaid vs postpaid.

data_need.description: Minimum data: light ≥2GB, moderate ≥5GB, heavy ≥20GB, unlimited = unlimited plans only.

lines.description: Number of phone lines to price.

preferred_network.description: Preferred underlying network, e.g. AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile.

prepaid_or_postpaid.description: Restrict to prepaid or postpaid plans; omit for both.

name: compare-mobile-plans

oldestVerifiedDate.description: Oldest verified_date among the plans shown.

billedAnnually.description: Paid upfront for a year; price is the per-month equivalent.

effectivePricePerLine.description: 12-month average USD per line; the ranking price.

steadyStatePricePerLine.description: Regular USD per line after any promo.

selectionNote.description: Curated selection of N plans from M providers, not the whole market.

title: Compare US Mobile Phone Plans
